Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square waist-up profile illustration of ONE original adult male dwarf of Moria, Khazad-dum, for The One Ring. Match the approved warm brown character portrait collection: fine muted reddish umber pen/pencil contours, medium-density directional hatching and selective crosshatching, small rich dark brown recesses, broad light ivory paper highlights. Latest portrait is a STYLE reference only, do not copy the human anatomy, face or river gear.
Subject: a compact broad powerful older dwarf, very short thick neck, massive shoulders, wide weathered angular face, heavy brow, broad blunt nose, deep-set watchful eyes and a stern thoughtful expression. Thick long beard with one central braid and two shorter side braids secured with simple angular metal bands, receding hairline and swept-back thick hair. Practical underground expedition clothing: worn mail collar beneath a heavy quilted tunic, reinforced leather shoulder pieces with restrained angular geometric edging, short weathered hooded mantle with hood down. One large naturally drawn hand grips the wooden haft of a sturdy mining pick at chest height, compact pick head visible beside shoulder and wholly within frame. A small unlit hooded lantern hangs at his belt near lower edge, secondary and clearly drawn. Modest craft details and wear, no royal crown, no gold treasure or glowing magical effects.
Distinct dwarven compact anatomy, different face and beard arrangement from the Erebor portrait. Three-quarter view with head centered and ample margin for avatar cropping; include torso, hand and upper tool. Slightly stylized traditional fantasy book character illustration. Beard in defined locks with cream gaps and dark hatched pockets, face shaped by selective expressive contours and short hatch clusters under brow, beside nose and under cheek. Cloth and leather folds shaded following form, economical mail marks, lit skin and fabric mostly bare paper. Nearly white cream paper background with faint sparse sketch hatching behind shoulders fading to blank. No cave scenery, lettering, border, watermark, photographic actor likeness, skin pores, smooth blended realistic shading, gray graphite wash, full color fills, thick cartoon outlines or sparse coloring-book simplicity. One single character, square 1:1 intended final 640x640 WebP profile.
